reading_note: The teaching describes the indispensability of the five discrete degrees of reception: if any one of the five levels by which divine good descends and ascends were lacking, the entire spiritual order would collapse. The arc moves from the structural necessity of the fivefold whole, through a description of the helplessness of those still in the natural plane (unable to reach the height, breadth, length, or depth of the higher states), into the revelation of five great spiritual truths: (1) that human souls belong to the genus of Light — divine truth; (2) the nature of the heavenly states; (3) the nature of falsity and how truth shames it; (4) the soul's coming to the threshold of natural death and being led out through the upper gate of the lower world; (5) the binding of those who cover over the Good and righteousness with falsity. The single arc: the fivefold completeness of divine order makes possible both the descent of light into the body and the ascent of the soul out of death.
